note: Michaux State Forest rustic camping area in the Big Flat parking lot off Birch Run Rd: nine signed sites (001A-001I), all pull-throughs listed for vehicles up to 45 ft, suitable for camping with horses. Non-flush toilet nearby; no water, hookups, dump or trash service (pack out). Reservation and permit required through the PA State Parks & Forests reservation system or 888-PA-PARKS (888-727-2757). Open in winter too (one of four Michaux sites kept open from the third Sunday after Thanksgiving to April 1; forest roads are not plowed). Campfires prohibited Mar 1-May 25. Michaux district office 717-352-2211. No water body adjacent. --Claude
summary: Confirmed no hookups/dump, reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit, pull-throughs. Added 9 sites (001A-001I) with a 45-ft max, non-flush toilet, no showers/water, reservation required, open year round (a designated winter site). Note corrected: these are State Forest Rustic sites in a parking area, not scattered roadside sites, and the length is now known. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
